selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What big project did the king begin to make for his purpose?
questions.answer: He began building a huge and beautiful palace.

questions.question: What did the king use from his own wealth to decorate the palace?
questions.answer: He used valuable treasures and beautiful crafted works.

questions.question: How was the palace connected to the king’s own abilities?
questions.answer: It was decorated and arranged by the king’s own treasures, art, wisdom, and knowledge.

questions.question: What does the phrase about each group having a fitting table help us understand?
questions.answer: It helps us understand that the arrangements were thoughtful and suitable for different people.

questions.question: What was the teacher meant to make known about the palace itself?
questions.answer: He was meant to make known its purpose, meanings, and secrets.

questions.question: What does it mean that the king invited subjects from all regions?
questions.answer: It means the invitation was wide and meant for all parts of his kingdom.

questions.question: What help did the main teacher have in the palace?
questions.answer: He had assistants in every section of the palace.

questions.question: What happened after the teacher gathered with his students in the biggest room?
questions.answer: He made an announcement to all the people watching.

questions.question: What happened right before the teacher spoke to everyone?
questions.answer: He remained with his students in the largest room while his assistants were spread through the palace.

questions.question: What was the palace like in size and beauty?
questions.answer: It was very large, grand, and richly decorated.

questions.question: Into what did the king divide the palace?
questions.answer: He divided it into splendid rooms and living spaces.

questions.question: Why were the food tables an important part of the palace?
questions.answer: They showed generosity and gave blessings for the guests to enjoy.

questions.question: Why is the banquet described in such a rich and impressive way?
questions.answer: To show the king’s generosity and the amazing care put into what was offered.

questions.question: What was special about the food prepared in the palace?
questions.answer: It included many kinds of delicious food and generous gifts.

questions.question: Why did the king appoint a highest-ranking teacher?
questions.answer: He appointed him to explain the palace, its maker, its decorations, and the right way to behave there.

questions.question: Why were the official ceremonies important?
questions.answer: They showed the respectful way the king wanted people to act.

questions.question: What was one job of the teacher in relation to the visitors?
questions.answer: He had to teach them the right manners and ceremonies.

questions.question: What happened after all these arrangements were made?
questions.answer: The teacher addressed all the spectators.

questions.question: What did the king do first in carrying out his plan?
questions.answer: He built a great palace.

questions.question: What does the passage show about the king’s personal role in the palace’s beauty?
questions.answer: He personally adorned it with great artistry.

questions.question: How do we know the king wanted the guests to feel honored?
questions.answer: He prepared rich tables, arranged them carefully, and invited people from everywhere.

questions.question: How was knowledge shown in the palace?
questions.answer: It was shown through remarkable and skillful works throughout the palace.

questions.question: What can you say about the palace from the way it was built and decorated?
questions.answer: It was made with great beauty, order, and careful skill.

questions.question: What role did the assistants play in the teaching mission?
questions.answer: They helped spread guidance through every part of the palace.

title: 11 Word Construction of the Palace and Appointment of the Explaining Master
